independence.why_this_frame: Rows 21-40 carry no binding spot check at sha 315c19145065. flash-11 checked part of this frame at superseded sha fe4b48bb3dbd; worker-086 sampled rows 1,4,9,16,17,25,33,96,97 and worker-07 sampled rows 41,49,57,65,73,80,81,89 at the current sha. Row 25 is deliberately re-sampled as an independent replication of worker-086's MISMATCH finding.

sampling_rule.S1_frame_stride: data rows 21-40 of ledger/citation_audit.csv; every 3rd row starting at 22 -> rows 22,25,28,31,34,37,40 (7 rows)
sampling_rule.S2_targeted_class_coverage: rows 45 and 75 (only AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH rows outside the frame that are not in worker-07's stride or worker-086's sample); declared before any fetch so the scalar-sph class is represented in this independent check

method.primary_locator_policy: arxiv_id present -> arXiv API https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=<id>&max_results=1 (primary). Else DOI present -> Crossref API https://api.crossref.org/works/<doi> (primary). The ledger's own exact_locator is never used as evidence; a search-query exact_locator is recorded only as a locator-quality datum.
method.secondary_locator: for rows with both arxiv_id and a non-arXiv DOI, the Crossref DOI record is also fetched as a secondary cross-check of year/venue; it does not change the primary verdict
method.raw_evidence: HTTP body bytes saved verbatim under artifacts/worker-026/l1_spotcheck/raw/<citation_id>.<ext>; sha256 computed on the unmodified body
method.normalisation: lowercase; strip a leading '<LABEL> abstract/excerpt:' prefix; strip surrounding quotes and ellipses; collapse whitespace; strip LaTeX math delimiters and backslash commands; map unicode dashes/quotes to ASCII
comparisons: first_author_match = ledger first author's last token appears in the fetched author list

verdict_rule.MATCH: title_similarity >= 0.95 AND first_author_match AND |year_delta| <= 1 AND (excerpt_similarity_first400 >= 0.60 OR ledger excerpt is a normalised substring of the fetched abstract)
verdict_rule.PARTIAL: title_similarity >= 0.85 but at least one MATCH condition unmet, or excerpt_similarity_first400 in [0.25, 0.60)
verdict_rule.MISMATCH: title_similarity < 0.85 (identifier resolves to a different work), or excerpt_similarity_first400 < 0.25 with a non-empty fetched abstract, or author entirely different

method.locator_quality_flag: exact_locator containing 'search_query=' or '?q=' is a search query, not an exact identifier -> recorded as a LOCATOR-QUALITY note; not by itself a MISMATCH
method.fail_closed_void_condition: if sha256(ledger/citation_audit.csv) != 315c19145065a5f9c95d64461eae760b4c296b06d1f2f09bc5847ac1a7064ce9 at any read (before, during, after fetch) the whole check is VOID and no row verdicts are reported

falsifier: A re-measurement showing (a) sha256(ledger/citation_audit.csv) != 315c19145065a5f9c95d64461eae760b4c296b06d1f2f09bc5847ac1a7064ce9 during the window, (b) a fetched raw body whose sha256 does not match the recorded value, (c) a row where the primary identifier resolves to a demonstrably different work than the ledger title, or (d) a MATCH verdict whose excerpt similarity is below the declared threshold. Any of these voids or downgrades the corresponding verdict.
non_claims: This is a spot check on 9 of 97 data rows, not a verdict on ledger/citation_audit.csv and not a G-LIT gate verdict.
It does not re-derive any theorem or reassess class mapping; it only tests whether the ledger's bibliographic claim is supported by the identified primary source.
It does not modify the ledger or any canonical artifact; the ledger hash is re-measured only to detect drift.
A worker event cannot set node status=done, validation_status=passed, or a gate verdict.
